newsitem.title: POLAND: CHASE IN $225 MLN LOT LOAN.
newsitem.headline: CHASE IN $225 MLN LOT LOAN.

text.p: Poland's national air carrier LOT mandated Chase Manhattan Bank and Polish Bank Pekao SA to arrange $225 million financing for the purchase five Boeing jets, LOT said in a statement on Thursday.
Late last year LOT had said it would buy four new Boeing 737s worth about $160 million from Boeing Commercial Airplane Group. No one at LOT was immediately available for comment on Thursday.
The statement said Boeing would supply LOT with four 737s and one 767, most likely in April, May and June, which would lift LOT's number of planes to 28.
It said the long-distance B 767-300 ER and two medium-distance B 737-400s would fly North American, Asian and European routes.
Two B 737-300 planes would go to LOT's charter connections largely with southern Europe and northern Africa.
The statement said LOT expected to carry 13.6 percent more passengers this year than the 2.033 million passengers carried last year.
LOT is slated for a partial sell-off by mid-1998.
